subject: english
stem: Listen to this report before making a decision. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on Tuesday
History Photo Hour begins at five twenty in the science room
History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday
History Photo Hour begins at ten o'clock on next Friday

optionRationales.reason: History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on Tuesday：此項把「next Friday」改成「Tuesday」。音稿明確陳述「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。因此，鎖定證據支持「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。

History Photo Hour begins at five twenty in the science room：此項把「on next Friday」改成「in the science room」。音稿明確陳述「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。因此，鎖定證據支持「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。
History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。

History Photo Hour begins at ten o'clock on next Friday：此項把「five twenty」改成「ten o'clock」。音稿明確陳述「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。因此，鎖定證據支持「History Photo Hour begins at five twenty on next Friday」。
